subject: POC hands-on session: logistics, access & recording permissions

Subject: POC hands-on session — proposed dates & draft agenda

Laura / Tim —

Thanks for agreeing to a hands-on POC with our team. To keep this concrete, proposed options are below (we can do hybrid if some of your team are remote):

- Option A: Thu, Apr 22 — 09:30–12:30 (morning)
- Option B: Thu, Apr 22 — 13:30–16:30 (afternoon)
- Option C: Fri, Apr 23 — 10:00–13:00

Draft agenda (attached): prompt review and best-practices (30m), routing & latency checks (30m), full load run (30m), breakouts for integration/Q&A (60m).

Practical items we need to confirm: room booking (onsite), visitor access passes for external attendees, screen-share/recording permissions, and a 30-minute window for a controlled load test. I attached a one-page agenda and our floor plan for the preferred training room on Level 3.

If you can confirm preferred option and whether you prefer fully onsite vs hybrid I’ll lock resources and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Rishi

rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Rishi —

Thanks, this looks great. Our core team prefers Option B (afternoon) on Thu Apr 22. Two quick asks:

1) We need confirmation on visitor access — our security requires pre-registered names and a visitor form.
2) We're fine with a short load test but please do not record any sessions without explicit approval from our legal team.

Headcount likely 6 on-site (myself, Tim, and 4 engineers) and 2 remote product folks. Once you confirm the room and passes I’ll approve on our side.

Team —

ClarityRetail confirmed Option B (Thu 4/22 afternoon) and emphasized: pre-registered visitor names + no recordings without customer sign-off. They expect ~6 onsite and 2 remote. Can you help with the following?

- Marissa: can you secure Level 3, Training Room B (floor plan attached)? If that room can't be confirmed, propose an alternative with hybrid AV.
- Priyom: coordinate visitor pass process and send the short visitor_pass_form to Laura to collect names. Also confirm Wi-Fi/guest credentials for external devices.
- Sergio: we plan a 30-min load window at ~14:00. Can you prepare the load_test_script_v2.txt and confirm capacity (GPUs/throughput) and a rollback plan if the run affects shared infra?

I’m copying Laura so she sees the operational asks.

Rishi

Quick update — Training Room B on Level 3 is already reserved for a partner briefing in the morning, but appears free 13:00 onwards. I can reserve 13:30–16:30 for us. Two notes:

- I'll attach the visitor_pass_form (PDF) and a short checklist for AV techs. Please ask the customer to return names by Tue end so Security can pre-print badges.
- For hybrid, we will use the room's Polycom setup + Zoom. Screen-share: customer laptops can share; however, by default the room recording is disabled. If Clarity wants recording we need signed permission (email OK but Legal prefers an explicit consent doc).

Sergio — I tested a short throughput bump on a staging pool and left notes in the load_test_script_v2.txt (Drive link below). If we push a sustained 2x load during the 14:00–14:30 window we should be fine, but recommend a canary at the start of the window followed by the main run.

Calendar: I created a tentative invite (see link) and will finalize once Rishi confirms with Laura.
